articles.title: Dollar firms as hot inflation, hawkish Fed talk lift rate-hike bets
articles.desc: The US dollar has gained against multiple currencies due to expectations of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. Inflation data revealed an increase in consumer prices, prompting trader speculation about further monetary tightening. The Japanese yen has weakened to its lowest level in over two months, approaching significant mark. Many developed-market currencies are performing poorly against the dollar this year, attributed to widening interest-rate gaps.

articles.title: Nasdaq futures rise nearly 2% as CoreWeave earnings calm AI spending fears
articles.desc: Futures for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 have shown gains following CoreWeave's impressive earnings announcement. Investors reacted positively as CoreWeave predicts profitability by the first half of 2028. Nvidia's shares rebounded after a significant drop attributed to CEO Jensen Huang's controversies. Meanwhile, inflation data has increased expectations of interest rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve. The bond market remained closed for the Veterans Day holiday, impacting trading.

articles.desc: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to achieve its $1 trillion goods and services export target in FY27, having already recorded nearly $480 billion in exports during April-September. He highlighted opportunities from free trade agreements, particularly the proposed India-EU pact, for the automobile and mobility sectors. Goyal urged manufacturers to expand globally, boost competitiveness and leverage international partnerships to drive exports, investment and employment.
